scripts.dev: pnpm build:protocol && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @codefly/server dev" "pnpm --filter @codefly/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:protocol && pnpm --filter @codefly/server build && pnpm --filter @codefly/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:protocol && pnpm --filter @codefly/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @codefly/web typecheck
